strands.name: Strand A: STEM Skills, Careers, and Connections

overalls.title: STEM Investigation Skills
overalls.description: apply a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations, making connections between their research and the scientific concepts they are learning

specifics.description: I can use scientific research and experimentation processes to plan and conduct investigations safely.
I can apply an engineering design process to design, build, and test devices or models.
I can use coding skills to investigate and model scientific concepts and relationships.
I can apply WHMIS and safe laboratory practices when carrying out hands-on investigations.

overalls.title: Applications, Careers, and Connections
overalls.description: design an experiment or a prototype to explore a problem relevant to a STEM-related occupation, using findings from research

specifics.description: I can explore STEM careers and evaluate the societal, economic, and environmental impacts of scientific developments.

strands.name: Strand B: Sustainable Ecosystems and Climate Change

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: assess impacts of climate change on sustainable ecosystems, and evaluate climate change initiatives

specifics.description: I can evaluate human impacts and climate change effects on ecosystem sustainability and biodiversity.

overalls.title: Investigating Ecosystem Dynamics
overalls.description: investigate ecosystem sustainability and factors affecting ecosystem health

specifics.description: I can explain nutrient cycles (carbon, nitrogen, water) and energy flow in ecosystems.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: assess impacts of chemical applications on society and the environment

specifics.description: I can evaluate the environmental and societal impacts of chemical use and waste.

overalls.title: Investigating Physical and Chemical Properties
overalls.description: investigate physical and chemical properties of elements and compounds

specifics.description: I can classify matter, determine physical/chemical properties, and explain atomic structure using the periodic table.

strands.name: Strand D: Principles and Applications of Electricity

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: evaluate social, economic, and environmental implications of electrical energy production

specifics.description: I can compare renewable and non-renewable energy sources and evaluate electrical efficiency.

overalls.title: Investigating Electrical Circuits
overalls.description: investigate characteristics of static and current electricity and circuit components

specifics.description: I can construct and analyze static electric phenomena and series/parallel electric circuits using Ohm's Law.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: evaluate social, environmental, and economic impacts of space exploration technologies

specifics.description: I can assess the contributions of space exploration technologies and Canadian space innovations.

overalls.title: Investigating Celestial Phenomena
overalls.description: investigate characteristics of the solar system and universe

specifics.description: I can describe the components, motion, and origin of celestial objects in our solar system and universe.
